task.title: Dragging toward an off-screen column doesn't scroll the board horizontally
task.description: The horizontal sibling of WB-01M004S4ANAEM0Z46HV2914NFK (PR #105), confirmed real during its implementation and review: holding a dragged card at the window's left or right edge leaves [data-board].scrollLeft unchanged, so a card cannot be dragged to a column beyond the current horizontal viewport in one gesture. The fix should reuse PR #105's machinery — the rAF loop, edge zones with a proportional ramp, the sub-pixel carry, and the dragenter/dragDestination acceptance — applied to the board's horizontal scroller, with the same discipline: real-browser proof of the full gesture, loop-leak checks on every termination path, and drop-marker integrity while the board scrolls under a stationary cursor.
